entries.6e0a66386634caeb: Since its founding in 1926, under its corporate motto “Creation, Harmony, Sincerity,” the company has aimed to create new value for calcium carbonate, a safe and secure material created by the earth, and to support people's rich lives through sincere manufacturing.
